description: Source code for a Docx file loader component in a larger document processing system, implementing the INode interface, with methods for loading and processing DOCX files, including metadata handling and text splitting.

classes.name: Docx_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing INode to load DOCX files, process metadata, and optionally split documents into smaller parts.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Docx_DocumentLoaders instance with predefined properties and input/output configurations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously loads DOCX files from storage or data URIs, processes metadata, applies text splitting if specified, and returns either document objects or concatenated text.
